question: On which river is 'National Waterway-6' (NW-6) proposed?
solution: The length of NW-6 is approximately 121 km. This will facilitate better connectivity and trade between the north-eastern states.

question: In which year was Indian Railways nationalized?
solution: Nationalization of railways ensured uniform railway administration and development throughout the country. Today Railways is the largest employer of the Government of India.

question: How many 'Coastal Economic Zones' (CEZ) are being developed under the 'Sagarmala' project?
solution: The objective of the CEZ is to create a manufacturing hub that will provide employment to lakhs of people and increase exports.

question: Where is the headquarters of North Central Railway (NCR) located?
solution: Prayagraj is an important railway junction. It is important to remember the headquarters of railway zones from exam point of view as it is often asked in matching questions.

question: Which city of Uttar Pradesh is known for 'Railway Coach Factory'?
solution: Rae Bareli factory is the third coach manufacturing unit of Indian Railways. It is considered very advanced in terms of technology.

question: In which city was the first metro rail service started in India?
solution: Kolkata Metro is also recognized as the 17th zone of Indian Railways. Today metro services operate in more than 15 cities of India.

question: Which is the only 'corporate' major port of India?
solution: Ennore Port was built primarily to transport coal. This is a successful model of public-private partnership.

question: What is called 'Greenfield Airport'?
options: Which are built from scratch on new and undeveloped land
Those that run only on solar power
Which are built only near forests
Which are built by upgrading the old airport
solution: Jewar Airport (Noida) and Navi Mumbai Airport are examples of greenfield projects. Whereas the expansion of Delhi airport is a brownfield project.

question: The world's highest railway bridge is built on which river?
solution: The height of Chenab Railway Bridge is 359 meters above the river bed, which is higher than the Eiffel Tower in Paris. It is part of the Udhampur-Srinagar-Baramulla rail link project.

question: Where is the headquarters of North Eastern Frontier Railway (NFR) located?
solution: NFR operates railways in the most challenging geographical areas. Darjeeling Himalayan Railway (Toy Train) comes under this zone.

question: 'NH 44' passes through how many states/union territories of India?
solution: NH 44 traverses the geographical diversity of India, traveling from the mountains of the north to the coasts of the south.

question: Who originally founded 'Air India'?
solution: J.R.D. Tata is considered the father of civil aviation in India. Air India has gone back to Tata Group in 2022.

question: National Waterway-5 (NW-5) is situated on which network of rivers?
solution: NW-5 is important for coal and mineral transportation. It helps to connect Talcher with Dhamra port.

question: Which state of India is emerging as 'Expressway State'?
solution: Uttar Pradesh has invested heavily in building expressways to increase its logistics and industrial speed, which is benefiting the state's economy.

question: What is the primary focus of 'Sagarmala Project'?
solution: The Sagarmala Project was launched by the Government of India in 2015. The vision of the scheme is to reduce logistics costs and improve export-import trade through investment in infrastructure. It has four main pillars: modernizing ports, improving port connectivity (by rail/road), creating industrial clusters near ports and developing coastal communities.

question: What is the full name of 'UDAN' scheme?
options: Common citizen of the country Flying
solution: Under the UDAN scheme, closed and underutilized regional airports have been revived. In this, subsidy is given on ticket prices.

question: Which is the most backward state of India in terms of road density?
solution: Road density is an indicator of the development of an area. Road construction in Himalayan states like Arunachal Pradesh is extremely difficult and expensive, due to which the density is low. The government is now making improvements here through the Border Roads Organisation.

question: In which year were air services started in India?
solution: The first flight was only 10 kilometers, but it laid the foundation of aviation history in India. Today India is the third largest domestic aviation market in the world.

question: Which is the deepest natural harbor of India?
solution: Visakhapatnam port is capable of handling large cargo vessels (Capesize Vessels) due to its depth. The Eastern Command Headquarters of the Indian Navy is also located here.

question: North-South Corridor connects which two places?
options: Silchar and Porbandar are the two end points of the East-West Corridor.
solution: The North-South and East-West corridors are India's largest ongoing highway projects. These corridors intersect each other in Jhansi city of Uttar Pradesh.

question: Where is 'Wheel and Axle Plant' located in India?
solution: This factory caters to the requirement of wheels and axles of Indian Railways. It was established to increase the self-reliance of the Railways.

question: In which year was 'Public Works Department' (PWD) established in road construction?
options: In which year was it established? A) 1888
solution: PWD is still the main agency for construction and maintenance of roads, bridges and government buildings in the states.

question: In which year was 'air transport' nationalized in India?
solution: The purpose of nationalization was to regulate air services and make them accessible to every part of the country. Recently Air India has again been handed over to Tata Group.

question: 'Chittaranjan Locomotive Works' (CLW) is located in which state of India?
solution: CLW is one of the largest locomotive manufacturing units in the world. It was established in 1950 in the name of Deshratna Deshbandhu Chittaranjan Das.

question: Integral Coach Factory (ICF) is located in which city of India?
solution: Indian Railways coaches are mainly manufactured in three factories - Perambur, Kapurthala and Rae Bareli. Perambur factory is the oldest and leading one.

question: Where is the headquarters of 'South Coast Railway' (SCoR) zone of Indian Railways proposed?
solution: This new zone was announced under the Andhra Pradesh Reorganization Act, to better serve the railway needs of the region.

question: What is the main objective of Bharatmala Project?
options: Improving the efficiency of movement of goods and passengers
solution: The first phase of the Bharatmala project was approved in October 2017. Under this, special attention is being given to the construction of economic corridors, feeder routes and border roads.

question: The historical 'Sher Shah Suri Marg' is currently known as which National Highway?
solution: Shershah Suri Marg was also called 'Sadak-e-Azam'. Presently NH 1 runs from Delhi to Amritsar (Attari Border), which is very important historically.

question: What is the total length of the Golden Quadrilateral?
solution: The Golden Quadrilateral Project has significantly reduced travel time between major economic centers of India and made freight movement faster.

question: What is the main objective of 'Gati Shakti' National Master Plan?
options: Integrated planning and implementation of infrastructure projects
solution: Under the Gati Shakti Yojana, coordination has been done between various ministries so that after the road is built, it does not have to be dug again and again for laying pipelines or cables.

question: 'NH 48' connects which major cities?
solution: NH 48 is one of the busiest highways in India, as it connects the country's political capital (Delhi) to the economic capital (Mumbai).

question: Which state of India has the maximum number of international airports?
solution: Uttar Pradesh has placed great emphasis on air connectivity in recent years. After construction of Jewar Airport (Noida), it will be one of the largest airports in Asia.

question: In which year was the Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI) established and where is its headquarters?
solution: IWAI works under the Ministry of Shipping. Its headquarters in Noida manages the projects of various national waterways of the country.

question: In which city of India the 'first heliport' (Rohini Heliport) has been opened?
solution: The heliport is used for independent operation of helicopters for emergency medical services, VIP travel and disaster management.

question: In which city is Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose International Airport located?
solution: Kolkata Airport is the largest aviation hub in eastern India and a major gateway to South-East Asia.

question: When did the first electric train 'Deccan Queen' run in India?
solution: The introduction of electric trains increased the speed of railways and reduced pollution. Today Indian Railways is moving towards 100% electrification of its entire network.

question: Which airport in India has received the 'World's Best Greenfield Airport' award?
solution: Hyderabad airport is completely modern and has advanced systems of biometric and digital check-in for the convenience of passengers.

question: East-West Corridor connects which two places?
solution: The length of the East-West corridor is approximately 3300 km. It provides an important road link between the east and west coasts of India.

question: 'Metro Rail' comes under which ministry in India?
options: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
solution: Metro projects usually have 50-50 percent participation between the central and state governments. Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) is a successful example of this.

question: Where is the headquarters of National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) located?
solution: NHAI was established in 1995. This institution not only builds highways but also promotes private investment through toll collection and PPP model.

question: In which state of India is the highest road density found?
solution: Road density means the length of roads per 100 square kilometers of area. Road density is highest in Kerala due to dense population and developed infrastructure, while it is lowest in Arunachal Pradesh due to rough mountain roads.

question: Where is Lokpriya Gopinath Bordoloi International Airport located?
solution: Gopinath Bordoloi was the first Chief Minister of Assam and a great freedom fighter. This airport has recently been handed over to private management (Adani Group).

question: Where has 'Vande Bharat Express' (Train 18) been manufactured?
solution: Vande Bharat Express has improved the image of technology and speed of Indian Railways globally. Its maximum speed can be up to 160-180 km/h.

question: Which is the smallest airport in India?
solution: Small airports are often used to increase regional connectivity under the 'UDAN' scheme. Airports such as Balzac connect remote areas to the mainland.

question: Which is the busiest railway junction in India? (where trains go in most directions)
solution: The geographical location of Mathura makes it a central point connecting North, South, East and West India.

question: Which is the oldest airport in India?
solution: JRD from Juhu Aerodrome itself. Tata flew India's first commercial flight. Currently it is mainly used for helicopter operations.

question: Which railway station of India has been renamed as 'Rani Kamalapati' railway station?
solution: Rani Kamalapati was the last Gond ruler of Bhopal. This station has been developed with modern facilities like an airport.

question: Which state of India has the lowest 'road density'? (except Himalayan states)
solution: Low road density means that people have to travel long distances to reach main roads. The government is carrying out reforms here under 'Bharatmala'.

question: Konkan Railway passes through which states?
solution: Konkan Railway has its headquarters at Navi Mumbai (Belapur). It was constructed under the leadership of E. Sreedharan, which includes many long tunnels and high bridges.

question: 'Kakinada-Puducherry' waterway comes under which national waterway number?
solution: NW-4 is an important waterway of South India, which helps in connecting industrial areas to ports. Its total length is approximately 1078 km.

question: Where is India's first railway university (National Rail and Transportation Institute) located?
solution: The name of this university has now been changed to 'Gati Shakti University'. It works to prepare skilled workforce in the transportation sector.

question: Which is the shortest national highway of India?
solution: A new system of changing the numbers of national highways has been implemented in India. Minor highways are often built to link a major highway or to connect a particular industrial/port area.

question: Which is the longest national highway of India?
solution: The total length of NH 44 is approximately 4112 kilometers. The highway passes through 11 states and several major cities in India, providing a major trade route between North and South India.

question: Which ministry maintains Indian National Highways?
options: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
solution: The ministry manages the roads through NHAI and PWD. The term 'North' (MoRTH) is also used for highways.

question: In which city do the North-South and East-West corridors intersect each other?
solution: The junction point of Jhansi is very important from strategic and transportation point of view. From here, passengers and goods can be easily sent to any corner of the country.

question: Approximately what percentage of India's total trade value is accounted for by sea transportation?
solution: Maritime transport is the backbone of India's economy. There are 12 major and many minor ports located on India's 7517 km long coastline which handle this trade.

question: Through which states does National Waterway-4 (NW-4) pass?
options: Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu and Puducherry
solution: The development of NW-4 is of utmost importance for the new capital Amaravati and industrial corridors of Andhra Pradesh.

question: In which city is 'Lal Bahadur Shastri' International Airport located?
solution: Varanasi airport has become very important due to it being the parliamentary constituency of the Prime Minister and a major global tourism hub.

question: Where is the headquarters of South Central Railway (SCR) located?
solution: Secunderabad Junction is one of the most important railway hubs of South India, located on the major route connecting the North and South.

question: When and between which stations did India's first train run?
options: 16 April 1853, India's first passenger train ran from Mumbai to Thane during the time of Lord Dalhousie for a distance of 34 km.
solution: The first train had three engines – Sahib, Sindh and Sultan. About 400 passengers traveled in it, which started a new era of transportation in India.

question: National Waterway-1 (NW-1) is situated on which river and from where?
options: West Coast Canal, Kollam to Kottapuram
solution: NW-1 passes through the states of Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand and West Bengal. It has become an important waterway for freight transportation through Varanasi.

question: When was 'Railway Budget' re-incorporated into the General Budget in India?
solution: Merging the Railway Budget with the General Budget has helped in better allocation of resources and improvement in the financial position of the Railways.

question: In which year was 'Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana' (PMGSY) started?
solution: PMGSY has transformed the economy of Indian villages. This has made it easier for farmers to reach markets and children to reach schools.

question: National Waterway-2 (NW-2) is situated on which river?
solution: The length of NW-2 is 891 km. It is a major trade route for north-eastern India, connecting Assam via Bangladesh.

question: Who was the Prime Minister of India at the time of the Golden Quadrilateral Project?
solution: Atal Bihari Vajpayee is considered the father of the development of modern road infrastructure in India. He also launched the Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY).

question: Which is the highway connecting Delhi and Kolkata under the Golden Quadrilateral?
solution: The Golden Quadrilateral is India's largest and the world's fifth longest highway network. It was designed for better transportation and economic development.

question: Which is the longest expressway in India? (As per PDF time)
solution: Expressways are high-speed routes where entry and exit are controlled. About 5,579 km long expressways are currently operational in India.

question: In which year was the National Highway Authority (NHAI) established?
solution: NHAI is the main body responsible for the development, maintenance and management of national highways in India. Its headquarters is located in New Delhi and it functions under the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways.

question: The 'Golden Quadrilateral' project connects which four major metros?
solution: The Golden Quadrilateral Project was started in 1999 by the then Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee. Its total length is 5846 kilometers, connecting industrial and cultural centres.

question: What does 'Brownfield Airport' mean?
options: Which are only for domestic flights
Expansion or modernization of an existing airport
Which are made only of soil
solution: The post-privatisation development of the airports of Delhi and Mumbai is an example of the 'brownfield' model. Whereas the manufacturing of jewelery is a 'greenfield' model.

question: What is approximately the total length of 'National Waterway-4' (NW-4)?
solution: The development of NW-4 is likely to reduce the cost of freight transportation between Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu by 30%.

question: Which national highway connects Kolkata and Chennai under the 'Golden Quadrilateral' project?
solution: NH 16 passes through West Bengal, Odisha, Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu. It is the lifeline for the ports of the Bay of Bengal.

question: 'Bullet Train' project is under construction between which two cities in India?
solution: Track is being laid between Sabarmati and Bandra Kurla Complex for the bullet train. It will also include a tunnel under the sea.

question: Which is India's first fully solar powered airport?
solution: Kochi Airport has been awarded the 'Champions of the Earth' award by the United Nations for this achievement. It is a global model of sustainable development.

question: Which is the highest airport in India?
solution: Leh airport is very important from strategic point of view. It is very challenging to fly here due to lack of oxygen and difficult weather.

question: Indian Railways is which largest railway network in the world?
solution: Indian Railways is considered the lifeline of the country. Lakhs of passengers travel in it every day and it is a cheap and effective means of transportation of goods.

question: National Waterway-3 (NW-3) is located in which state of India?
solution: NW-3 was the first waterway in India to provide round the clock navigation facilities. Its length is 205 km.

question: Who is known as 'Metro Man of India'?
solution: E. Sreedharan developed a new culture of completing projects within deadlines and with integrity. He has also been honored with Padma Vibhushan.

question: Which state of India has the longest length of railway lines?
solution: The geography of Uttar Pradesh is flat, making it easy to lay railway lines. Also, all major trains going towards east and north pass through here.

question: In which city has the first 'underwater metro' been started in India?
solution: Kolkata Metro is the oldest metro system in India, which was opened in 1984. The tunnel built under the Hooghly River is a wonderful example of engineering.

question: In which year was the Airports Authority of India (AAI) established?
solution: AAI manages a total of 137 airports in India, including civil enclaves in international, domestic and military airfields. Its headquarters is in New Delhi.

question: Which is the largest and busiest airport in India?
solution: Delhi airport has three terminals and four runways. It is a major aviation hub of South Asia. It has been declared completely solar and hydroelectric powered by February 2025.

question: In which year was the Border Roads Organization (BRO) established?
solution: BRO works under the Ministry of Defence. It not only builds roads in the northern and north-eastern border areas of India, but also works on important projects in neighboring countries (Bhutan, Myanmar).

question: What is the purpose of 'KAVACH' technology in Indian Railways?
options: It is the job of RPF to increase the security of stations.
solution: Kavach is India's own developed technology. If the loco pilot is unable to apply the brakes, this technology stops the train by automatically applying the brakes.

question: Where is the headquarters of East Coast Railway (ECoR) located?
solution: The East Coast Railway zone mainly provides rail services to Odisha, Chhattisgarh and parts of Andhra Pradesh.

question: Where is Diesel Locomotive Works (DLW) located in India?
solution: The Varanasi factory is now known as 'Banaras Locomotive Works' (BLW). From here, railway engines are also exported to foreign countries.

question: Where is the headquarters of 'Shipping Corporation of India' (SCI) in India?
solution: SCI is a Navratna company of the Government of India that operates and manages maritime vessels. It plays a big role in India's foreign trade.

question: India's largest river island 'Majuli' is located near which national waterway?
solution: Majuli is the largest river island in the world. The development of waterways has facilitated tourism and commercial access to the island.

question: Which is the busiest port of India?
solution: Jawaharlal Nehru Port handles about half the container traffic of India's maritime trade. It is completely modern and computerized.

question: How many railway zones are there in Indian Railways at present?
solution: Each railway zone is headed by a General Manager (GM). The headquarters of South Coast Railway is proposed in Visakhapatnam.

question: Where is Rail Spring Factory located in India?
solution: There are special units in different cities of India for different parts of railways. The Gwalior factory is known for spring and suspension systems.

question: Which is India's 'First Private Managed Station'?
solution: Private management has significantly improved cleanliness, safety and passenger amenities at the stations. Railway operations still remain with the Indian Railways.

question: Which zone of Indian Railways has its headquarters in Hubli?
solution: Hubli is not only the headquarters of the railway zone, but is also home to the world's longest railway platform.

question: Which state of India has the maximum total length of roads?
solution: Maharashtra has a wide network of state highways and rural roads. Maharashtra tops in terms of total road length, while Kerala is making its mark in density and Uttar Pradesh in expansion of expressways.

question: Which is the longest railway route in India?
solution: 'Vivek Express' runs on this route, which covers a distance of approximately 4233 kilometers. This train passes through many states of India and takes the longest time.
